approval_requests.uq_ar_composite_binding: UNIQUE (approval_request_id, project_id, task_id, merge_candidate_id, agent_commit_hash, base_main_commit_hash, merge_candidate_hash, verified_tree_hash, verification_run_id, review_artifact_id)

change_requests.idx_change_requests_decided_timeline: (project_id, pipeline_session_id, decided_at DESC, cr_id DESC) WHERE (decided_at IS NOT NULL)
change_requests.idx_change_requests_applied_timeline: (project_id, pipeline_session_id, applied_at DESC, cr_id DESC) WHERE (applied_at IS NOT NULL)

disposable_index_definitions:
CREATE INDEX probe_pending_cr ON change_requests (project_id, created_at DESC, cr_id DESC)
       WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'

CREATE INDEX probe_pending_approval ON approval_requests (project_id, created_at DESC, approval_request_id DESC)
       WHERE status = 'PENDING'

CREATE INDEX probe_waiting_tasks ON tasks (project_id, created_at DESC, task_id DESC)
       WHERE status = 'AwaitingHumanApproval'

baseline.sql:
SELECT cr_id, project_id, pipeline_session_id, baseline_id, cr_key, title, status, created_at
FROM change_requests WHERE project_id=$1 AND status='PENDING_APPROVAL'
ORDER BY created_at DESC, cr_id DESC LIMIT 101

SELECT cr_id, project_id, pipeline_session_id, baseline_id, cr_key, title, status, created_at
FROM change_requests WHERE project_id=$1 AND status='PENDING_APPROVAL'
ORDER BY created_at DESC, cr_id DESC LIMIT 101

SELECT approval_request_id, project_id, task_id, merge_candidate_id, status, expires_at, created_at
FROM approval_requests WHERE project_id=$1 AND status='PENDING'
ORDER BY created_at DESC, approval_request_id DESC LIMIT 101

SELECT approval_request_id, project_id, task_id, merge_candidate_id, status, expires_at, created_at
FROM approval_requests WHERE project_id=$1 AND status='PENDING' AND expires_at > now()
ORDER BY created_at DESC, approval_request_id DESC LIMIT 101

SELECT task_id FROM tasks WHERE project_id=$1 AND status='AwaitingHumanApproval'
ORDER BY created_at DESC, task_id DESC LIMIT 101
